name: cache-guard
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while you are away, asks before a prompt that would re-cache a large conversation, and with Jev (TypeSafe) keeps the context lean: trims large tool output and compacts in about a second.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: For Jev, which trims tool output and compacts in about a second (https://console.typesafe.ai/keys). Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment, or to go without Jev.
